LanguageData.RHAH_History_Y001_FamineChild.title: famine child
LanguageData.RHAH_History_Y001_FamineChild.baseDescri: [PAWN_nameDef] was small when the famine came to the Ratkin settlements. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to search refuse for food and to distrust anyone promising a full meal.
LanguageData.RHAH_History_A001_ReliefTrader.title: relief trader
LanguageData.RHAH_History_A001_ReliefTrader.baseDescr: [PAWN_nameDef] moved food and medicine between Ratkin settlements during the famine. [PAWN_pronoun] learned which promises could be traded and which ones would leave a caravan empty.
